Description:
Nelson County offers amazing opportunities and locations for climbing.

There are many respected and experienced rock climbing guides and outfitters who can literally show you the ropes of outdoor climbing.

Blue Ridge Mountain Guides provides customized rock and ice climbing trips and guiding for all abilities. Virginia has prime rock climbing nestled into the Blue Ridge Mountains! Within minutes of Wintergreen Ski Resort, cliffs range from 30-300’ tall with a variety of climbing styles. The Blue Ridge Parkway has both rock and ice climbs with low angle slabs, which are perfect for beginners, and vertical to overhung walls suited for advanced climbers looking to push their abilities. These areas are ideal for first time climbers, instructional courses, experiencing VA climbing, and preparing for big objectives.

Wild Guyde Adventures is are a family business intent on serving by providing high quality adventure leadership and learning. WILD GUYde Adventures LLC is incorporated in Virginia, and is fully insured for both general liability and major medical. Check out their website to learn about rock climbing and other adventures.

Pinnacle Ridge is located in the Priest Wilderness Area of the George Washington-Jefferson National Forest in Nelson County, Virginia. Just east of Crabtree Falls, it has fantastic views of the Priest, Three Ridges, and the valley below. Pinnacle has large granite slabs, numerous boulders, and challenging routes. Bouldering and traditional climbing using removable gear is allowed, but use of bolts or pitons is not.

Blackrock Park contains a large number of climbing crags, and has several weeks’ worth of different routes. This rock was created millions of years ago and is known as the Pedlar Formations. Not all the routes are directly off the trail, but some bush-whacking and treading without a trail is required to access different pitches, such as the East Walls. Blackrock Park is located in Wintergreen Resort.

Description:
Farm-Fresh is an understatement.

Our local Nelson County farms and orchards produce fresh fruits, vegetables, local organic meats, honey, cider, apple butter, jellies, jams, mushrooms, flowers, and so much more. Pick-your-own opportunities are available at select farms during the growing season and several farms feature choose and cut Christmas Trees in winter. Other unique locations feature products like lavender & herbs, goats & sheep, alpacas, edible plants, hops, vinegars, baked goods, and more.

Be sure to visit the Nelson Farmers Market on Saturday mornings, May through October, where a community of farmers and artisans showcase their products under the big white tent in the village of Nellysford. On Wednesday afternoons, the Village of Lovingston Farmers Market offers local produce, baked goods and more.

Out of season, visit the Indoor Community Market at Rockfish Valley Community Center, featuring local produce, meats, cheeses, jams, baked goods, plants, greenery, and arts and crafts items. (First Saturdays in Nov., Dec., Feb. Mar. and April).
